prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Spectrum 1-4: page #F9F9FB, text #251F2D, accent #861D85, secondary surface #EFEAE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in Inter; architectural sans heading with neutral interface text. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 14px, heading 36px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
